hold_text: This PR adds four NEW research/queue units (RQ-20261007-001..004), one NEW blocked unit (blocked/RQ-20261007-005) and corrects the blocked_on text of blocked/RQ-20260922-011 (its decision_rule is byte-identical). A new queue file is a registration, never a dispatch stamp, so STAMP_ONLY_SURFACE cannot vouch for it and TIER1_SURFACE deliberately excludes research/queue/** (a pre-registered decision rule must not self-land in the act that writes it). Everything else in the diff (the memo + index row, scripts/research, scripts/ci, tests, pipeline records, the checklist, these landing files) is inside the Tier-1 surface. The manager (session_01MM8o5js6TcDFeNAPBY4Ntv) lands lane PRs; the lane reports the PR number.
